hero.title: First jobs for students and new graduates

latestJobs.title: Latest jobs
latestJobs.subtitle: The newest posts from companies approved by Launchly.
latestJobs.emptyTitle: No job posts to show yet
latestJobs.emptyBody: Come back in a few minutes or open the jobs page to search.

features.title: Prepare well before you apply
features.subtitle: Three tools that stay with you from reading a job post to the interview.

cvReview.title: CV review for each job
cvReview.body: Pick a job post and AI compares your CV with its requirements, showing the skills you have and the ones you are missing.

interview.title: Practise interviews with AI
interview.body: Answer questions close to the role you are aiming for and get feedback on every answer.
interview.question: Tell me about a project you are most proud of?
interview.answer: I built a library management project with React...

process.title: Know the hiring process up front
process.body: Every post lists its hiring rounds and the company's notes. After applying, you know which round your application is in.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to your first job
howItWorks.subtitle: No long experience needed. A CV and a few minutes are enough to start.

profile.title: Create a profile and upload your CV
profile.body: Fill in the basics, upload a PDF CV once and reuse it for every application.

search.title: Find jobs and check your CV
search.body: Filter by level, field and location. Check your CV against the jobs you like before applying.

apply.title: Apply and track
apply.body: Apply right on the job post and see the status of every application on one page.

recruiter.title: Hiring interns or Freshers?
recruiter.body: Post jobs, describe every hiring round and review applicants in one place.
